feeds.title: The Gay UK Magazine
feeds.description: All the latest gay news from the UK and internationally. Listings for LGBT venues across the UK, plus gay chat, gay forums and hot gay men! Come and join our community. Expand your network and get to know new people!

feeds.title: Queer Little Family
feeds.description: A blog about parenting, LGBTQ, mental health, entertainment, gaming, poetry, writing and cats.

feeds.title: YATGB (Yet Another T-Girl Blog)
feeds.description: I'm a 40 something trans person from the UK. I'm happily married and with two kiddie-winks, life's interesting!

feeds.title: DIVA Magazine
feeds.description: DIVA brings you the latest in lesbian and bi-related celebrity interviews, news, politics, pop culture, style, travel, social issues, and entertainment. Also tackle the tough topics, like racism in the LGBTQI community, mental health, and the challenges facing queer youth, and profile inspirational women who are making a difference in the lives of lesbian, bi, and trans women.

feeds.title: Our Transitional Life
feeds.description: Hello, and welcome to Our Transitional Life! I'm Kelly and I run the blog with my lovely family. We are here to share a chunk of our life with you and confront discrimination and challenge society's ideals along the way.

feeds.title: Pink Wedding Days
feeds.description: A blog about gay weddings, civil partnerships and the LGBTQ-friendly venues and service providers supporting them. Follow this blog for news, tips, and tricks on gay weddings and civil partnerships in the UK.

feeds.title: Pink News
feeds.description: PinkNews covers politics, entertainment, religion and community news for the gay, lesbian, bisexual and transgender community.

feeds.title: Gay Times
feeds.description: Gay Times is the original, best, and longest-running magazine for a global community of gay and bisexual men. Leading the way in LGBTQ+ storytelling and delivering cutting-edge content since 1984. Follow Gay Magazine and get Gay News, Travel Guides, Saunas & Chat.

feeds.title: Boyz Magazine Blog
feeds.description: Boyz is a free, London-based magazine, targeted at gay men and distributed mainly through gay bars, pubs, clubs and saunas in the United Kingdom. Published weekly, it tends to focus on news about the gay scene and celebrities (generally pop artists) popular with young scene-going gay men.
